sql:
SELECT s.name 
FROM sets s 
JOIN set_translations st ON s.name = st.translation 
WHERE st.language = 'Korean' 
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM set_translations stj 
    WHERE stj.translation = s.name 
      AND stj.language LIKE '%Japanese%'
  )
GROUP BY s.name
